name: lchown32
synopsis: int lchown(const char *pathname, uid_t owner, gid_t group);
description: Changes the ownership of a file specified by pathname without dereferencing symbolic links. Only a privileged process can change the owner, and the owner can change the group to one they are a member of. If owner or group is -1, that ID is not changed.

parameters.name: pathname
parameters.description: Path to the file whose ownership is to be changed

parameters.name: owner
parameters.description: New owner user ID, or -1 to leave unchanged

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: New group ID, or -1 to leave unchanged

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

errors.description: Search permission is denied on a component of the path prefix
